english.meaning: to give change; to settle the balance owed
english.note: 找卡數 means to pay off the credit card bill.

exampleSentences.english: Sigh, having money to give change is better than having none. I don’t have any money at all.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唉，噉有錢找都好過冇錢找吖。我錢都冇啊直程。
